participant_1.name: Ella
participant_1.personality: Curious and adventurous, Ella enjoys discovering new places and flavors. She has a laid-back attitude towards sports, preferring experiences over competition.
participant_1.background: I'm terrified of scorpions. I'm employed by the US Postal Service. My favorite color is grey. My father drove a car for NASCAR. I've a German Shepherd named Barnaby.

participant_2.name: Liam
participant_2.personality: Liam is an enthusiastic traveler with a passion for culinary experiences. Despite his lack of cooking skills, he enjoys exploring diverse cuisines and is friendly and sociable.
participant_2.background: I also like to cook but I'm not very good at it. I have been trying all types of food everywhere I go. I have been traveling the world for a year. I own a yacht and I rent it out when I am not using it.
